nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $n$ and $m$ and every cell $c = (x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$, applying the cell map $(x, y) \mapsto (-1 - x, y)$ of the reflection $f$ twice returns $c$.
nodes.title: The reflection f of grid cells is an involution

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$, the reflection $f$ acts on the cells $(x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$ of the $n \times m$ grid by $(x, y) \mapsto (-1 - x, y)$, that is, $(x, y) \mapsto (n - 1 - x, y)$ with the first coordinate taken modulo $n$.
nodes.title: Cell map of the reflection f

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the quarter-turn $r$ acts on the cells $(x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ of the $n \times n$ grid by $(x, y) \mapsto (-1 - y, x)$, that is, $(x, y) \mapsto (n - 1 - y, x)$ modulo $n$.
nodes.title: Cell map of the quarter-turn r

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$, the reflection $r^2 f$ acts on the cells $(x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$ of the $n \times m$ grid by $(x, y) \mapsto (x, -1 - y)$, that is, $(x, y) \mapsto (x, m - 1 - y)$ with the second coordinate taken modulo $m$.
nodes.title: Cell map of the reflection r²f

nodes.summary: For natural numbers $n$ and $m$, the half-turn $r^2$ acts on the cells $(x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/m\mathbb{Z}$ of the $n \times m$ grid by $(x, y) \mapsto (-1 - x, -1 - y)$, that is, $(x, y) \mapsto (n - 1 - x, m - 1 - y)$ with the coordinates taken modulo $n$ and $m$.
nodes.title: Cell map of the half-turn r²

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the antidiagonal reflection $r^3 f$ acts on the cells $(x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ of the $n \times n$ grid by $(x, y) \mapsto (-1 - y, -1 - x)$, that is, $(x, y) \mapsto (n - 1 - y, n - 1 - x)$ modulo $n$.
nodes.title: Cell map of the antidiagonal reflection r³f

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the three-quarter turn $r^3$ acts on the cells $(x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ of the $n \times n$ grid by $(x, y) \mapsto (y, -1 - x)$, that is, $(x, y) \mapsto (y, n - 1 - x)$ modulo $n$.
nodes.title: Cell map of the three-quarter turn r³

nodes.summary: For a natural number $n$, the diagonal reflection $rf$ acts on the cells $(x, y) \in \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z} \times \mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z}$ of the $n \times n$ grid by $(x, y) \mapsto (y, x)$.
nodes.title: Cell map of the diagonal reflection rf

nodes.title: Fixed cylinder tilings of the reflection f, n even

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a finite set of tile designs, let $n, m \ge 1$ with $n$ odd, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $T$ with $\sigma^2 = 1$. Let $f$ be the cell map $(x, y) \mapsto (-1 - x, y)$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n \times \mathbb{Z}/m$, and let $t$ be the number of designs fixed by $\sigma$. Then the cylinder shift sum of $f$ and $\sigma$ equals $n \cdot |T|^{(nm - m)/2} \cdot t^m$.
nodes.title: Cylinder fixed-tiling count for the reflection $f$ when $n$ is odd

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a finite set of tile designs, let $n, m \ge 1$, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $T$ with $\sigma^1 = 1$, that is, the identity. Then the cylinder shift sum of the identity map of $\mathbb{Z}/n \times \mathbb{Z}/m$ and $\sigma$ equals $\sum_{d \mid n} \varphi(d)\, |T|^{nm/d}$, where $d$ runs over the positive divisors of $n$ and $\varphi$ is Euler's totient function.
nodes.title: Cylinder fixed-tiling count for the identity

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a finite set of tile designs, let $n, m \ge 1$ with $m$ even, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $T$ with $\sigma^2 = 1$. Let $r^2$ be the cell map $(x, y) \mapsto (-1 - x, -1 - y)$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n \times \mathbb{Z}/m$. Then the cylinder shift sum of $r^2$ and $\sigma$ equals $n \cdot |T|^{nm/2}$.
nodes.title: Cylinder fixed-tiling count for the half-turn when $m$ is even

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a finite set of tile designs, let $n, m \ge 1$ with $m$ odd and $n$ even, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $T$ with $\sigma^2 = 1$. Let $r^2$ be the cell map $(x, y) \mapsto (-1 - x, -1 - y)$ of $\mathbb{Z}/n \times \mathbb{Z}/m$, and let $t$ be the number of designs fixed by $\sigma$. Then twice the cylinder shift sum of $r^2$ and $\sigma$ equals $n \left(|T|^{nm/2} + |T|^{(nm - 2)/2}\, t^2\right)$.
nodes.title: Cylinder fixed-tiling count for the half-turn when $m$ is odd and $n$ is even

nodes.summary: Let $T$ be a finite set of tile designs, let $n, m \ge 1$, let $g$ be a map from the cells $\mathbb{Z}/n \times \mathbb{Z}/m$ to themselves, and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $T$. The cylinder shift sum of $g$ and $\sigma$ is the sum, over all shifts $a \in \mathbb{Z}/n$, of the number of tilings $F : \mathbb{Z}/n \times \mathbb{Z}/m \to T$ with $F(g(x + a, y)) = \sigma(F(x, y))$ for every cell $(x, y)$.
nodes.title: Cylinder shift sum

nodes.summary: On the grid $\mathbb{Z}/2 \times \mathbb{Z}/1$ with two tile designs, exactly two tilings $F$ satisfy $F(f(c)) = \sigma(F(c))$ for every cell $c$, where $f : (x, y) \mapsto (-1 - x, y)$ is the reflection exchanging the two cells and $\sigma$ swaps the two designs.
nodes.title: Fixed tilings of the $2 \times 1$ grid under reflection and a design swap

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set of cells, $T$ a finite set of tile designs, $\varphi$ a permutation of $\alpha$ and $\sigma$ a permutation of $T$. nodes.title: Fixed tilings as a product over orbits

nodes.summary: Let the set of cells and the set of tile designs both be the two-element set $\{0, 1\}$. The number of maps $F : \{0, 1\} \to \{0, 1\}$ with $F(\varphi(c)) = \sigma(F(c))$ for every cell $c$, where $\varphi$ is the identity map on cells and $\sigma$ is the identity permutation of designs, equals $4$; that is, all $2^2$ tilings are fixed.
nodes.title: Fixed tilings of two cells under the identity

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ (the cells) and $T$ (the tile designs) be finite sets, let $\varphi : \alpha \to \alpha$ be a map and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $T$. The number of tilings fixed by $(\varphi, \sigma)$ is the number of maps $F : \alpha \to T$ such that $F(\varphi(c)) = \sigma(F(c))$ for every $c \in \alpha$.
nodes.title: Number of fixed tilings

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set, $\varphi$ a permutation of $\alpha$ and $c \in \alpha$. The orbit of $c$ under $\varphi$ is the finite set $\{\varphi^k(c) : k \in \mathbb{N}\}$ of images of $c$ under the nonnegative powers of $\varphi$. Since $\alpha$ is finite, this is the orbit of $c$ under the cyclic group generated by $\varphi$.
nodes.title: Orbit of a cell under a permutation

nodes.summary: Let $\alpha$ be a finite set and $\varphi$ a permutation of $\alpha$. For $c \in \alpha$ let $O(c) = \{\varphi^k(c) : k \in \mathbb{N}\}$ be the orbit of $c$ under $\varphi$. The set of orbits of $\varphi$ is the set $\{O(c) : c \in \alpha\}$ of subsets of $\alpha$, in which each orbit occurs once.
nodes.title: Orbits of a permutation

nodes.title: No solutions of $x = -1-x-a$ modulo $n$ when $n$ and $a$ are even

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a positive even integer and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/n$ whose representative $\bar a \in \{0, \dots, n-1\}$ is odd. Then the set of $x \in \mathbb{Z}/n$ with $x = -1-x-a$ consists of the residues mod $n$ of the integers $(-1-\bar a)/2$ and $(n-1-\bar a)/2$.
nodes.title: Solutions of $x = -1-x-a$ modulo even $n$ for odd $a$

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be a positive odd integer and $a \in \mathbb{Z}/n$. Then the set of $x \in \mathbb{Z}/n$ with $x = -1-x-a$ is the singleton $\{k(-1-a)\}$, where $k$ is the residue mod $n$ of the integer $(n+1)/2$.
nodes.title: Solution of $x = -1-x-a$ modulo odd $n$

nodes.title: The dihedral action on the cells of the square grid

nodes.summary: Let $n$ be an even positive integer, let $T$ be a finite set and let $\sigma$ be a permutation of $T$ with $\sigma^2 = 1$. Let $f$ be the reflection of the grid $(\mathbb{Z}/n\mathbb{Z})^2$ given by $f(x, y) = (-1 - x, y)$. can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
